root_cause: The top-level instantiation is out of sync with the stage modules it instantiates. It is a hybrid of a legacy ex_stage interface and the current one: rv32i5.sv drives u_ex_stage with bp_resolve_valid/bp_resolve_pc/bp_resolve_type/bp_resolve_taken/bp_resolve_target/bp_mispredict, which are not ports of ex_stage.sv, so elaboration fails. At the same time, the required input wb_data (reported as wb_wdata) on u_ex_stage, and the prediction-passthrough chain ifid_pred_valid/ifid_pred_next_pc (if_stage → id_stage) and idex_pred_valid/idex_pred_next_pc (id_stage → ex/ID-EX), are left unconnected. That leaves the nets behind them, especially bp_resolve_valid/bp_resolve_taken/bp_mispredict, undriven and therefore X. This is a pure interface/wiring generation mismatch; the pipeline datapath logic itself has not yet been exercised.
failing_checks: wiring_missing_port_connections: u_id_stage(id_stage) missing idex_pred_next_pc, idex_pred_valid, ifid_pred_next_pc, ifid_pred_valid
repair_constraints: Never rename modules, files or ports; rv32i5's public port set must match the plan interfaces exactly (clk/rst_n/imem_*/dmem_*/dbg_reg_addr/dbg_reg_data/halted/exit_code/dbg_features/dbg_retire_valid/dbg_retire_pc/dbg_retire_insn/dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict/dbg_ooo_issue/dbg_ooo_bypass).

Do not instantiate ports on u_ex_stage that ex_stage.sv does not declare (bp_resolve_pc/type/taken/target, bp_mispredict); either derive dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict inside the responsible module that owns the resolve state (ex_stage or the top-level resolve logic), or wire them to an existing real driver. Never leave bp_resolve_valid/bp_resolve_taken/bp_mispredict as undriven nets.

if_stage must register bp_pred_valid/bp_pred_next_pc into ifid_pred_valid/ifid_pred_next_pc on the IF/ID clock edge and clear them together with ifid_valid on flush/redirect/stall; the top-level must connect these outputs to id_stage's ifid_pred_* inputs.
id_stage must forward ifid_pred_valid/ifid_pred_next_pc into idex_pred_valid/idex_pred_next_pc and clear them together with idex_valid on flush/halt; the top-level must drive both ends explicitly.

Every declared input port of every instance must be explicitly connected (no implicit X): in particular the writeback data path into ex_stage (wb_data, reported as wb_wdata) must be wired to the WB result used for forwarding and store-data selection.

Keep all port widths and signedness as declared; dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict must come from real pipeline resolve state (no counter or PC-pattern synthesis), and reset must not produce phantom resolve events.
